text: INT. AVA'S FAMILY DINING ROOM - DAY1 1

The dining room is sparsely furnished and worn. CARL JOHNSON (Ava’s father) and MARY JOHNSON (Ava’s grandmother) sit at the dining table. Next to them is CASH JOHNSON (Ava’s older brother), with a small cake in front of him. Cash closes his eyes to make a wish, while DORA JOHNSON (Ava’s mother) looks on with pride. Ava watches Cash and the cake with envy. Dora pats AVA JOHNSON (19) on the shoulder. DORAYou and Cash are twins. It’s your birthday too. Go ahead, make a wish. Ava sneakily stands behind Cash, and closes her eyes to make a wish. With his eyes closed, Cash blows out the candles. Mary takes out the candles and slices the cake into four pieces, gives the largest slice, which is the only one with strawberry to *Cash. MARYHere you go, Cash! The biggest piece is for you! Cash takes it eagerly, grinning at Mary. CASHThanks, Grandma! I love cake with strawberries the most! Mary gives Carl a big slice and gives herself a smaller slice. Ava carefully reaches for the last piece of cake and Mary sees it and slaps Ava's hand away hard. MARYWhat are you doing? The last piece is saved for your brother! Sneaking food at such a young age? Greedy brat! Ava clutches her hand, frightened and silent. Dora hears this and rushes forward, shielding Ava. DORAMom! Today is Ava’s birthday too. You’re favoring Cash—can’t Ava even have a bite?

Before she finishes, Mary slaps Dora hard across the face. MARYShut up! You have no say here! Get back to work! Cash notices some frosting on his clothes and takes off his jacket. Dora grabs Ava and starts to leave when Cash throws the dirty jacket at Ava. CASHAva, wash this for me! I need it for tomorrow! Dora takes the jacket off Ava and suppresses her anger as she glares at Cash. DORACash! She’s your sister, not the family maid! Before Cash can respond, Carl slams the table and stands, glaring at Ava. She cowers behind Dora in fear. CARLShe’s worse than a maid!(glares at Ava)Lazy and spoiled! The cake is for your brother! You don’t deserve it! Now get to work! All you ever do is cry and whine, you little piece of shit! Carl moves toward Ava in a fury, raises his hand to hit Ava. Dora steps in front of Ava and gets slapped hard by Carl. Dora’s hurt, the corner of her lip bleeding. Ava sobs, throwing herself on Dora’s body. AVAMom! Mom, are you okay? Dora wipes the blood from her mouth, stands up, and moves Ava behind her. DORAIf you want to pick on someone, come at me! Ava’s just a kid! CARLYou think I won’t beat the shit out of you? It’s all because of you!

You raised Ava to be a selfish, spoiled brat! I’d better teach you a good, hard lesson, you bitch! Carl picks up a stick from the side, lunging toward mother and daughter with it. Dora protects Ava, who CRIES in fear. Mary’s about to step forward and stop them, when Dora suddenly spits out a mouthful of blood. Dora collapses！ * AVAMom! Everyone freezes.
INT. AVA’S FAMILY BEDROOM - DAY2 2

Dora sits weakly on the bed. Ava hands Dora a glass of water. Carl, Cash, and Mary sit on nearby stools. DORAI'm fine... Dora attempts to sit up, but Ava gently pushes her back down. AVAMom! The doctor already told you that you've got a gastric ulcer from overexertion. You need to rest! MARY(impatiently)What a useless creature! What kind of wife collapses from just doing household chores and starts coughing up blood! CARLThe hospitals are not our personal nursing home. If you're done resting, get back in the kitchen. Those dishes aren't going to wash themselves! Ava can no longer hold back her anger and responds to Carl. AVADad! Mom is so sick she can’t even get out of bed, and you’re still making her work! We need to take her to the hospital!

Carl, enraged, strides over and slaps Ava. She cries out, clutching her face. Dora rushes to hold Ava’s hand, her heart aching. DORADon’t hit her! CARLWhere would we get the money to treat your mother? You know our situation well enough! Starting tomorrow, you’ll stay home to take care of your mother! AVADad! I just got an offer from a big company! I need this job! Why should I stay home while Cash does nothing? He’s also her son! CARL(enraged)You owe this family! You won't get a single penny for your travel! Let’s see how you leave! You’re staying to care for your mother and the house and that's final! Ava, her face stinging, glares at Carl. Cash, feigning innocence, steps forward, playing the dutiful son. CASHDad! Grandma! I’ll stay and take care of Mom. If Ava insists on working, let her go. I can handle things here. CARLNo! I worked hard to secure you a job. Focus on it and do it well! (to Ava)As for you, you were the reason for your stillborn brother, leaving your mother unable to have more children. Now you must make amends. You owe this family for life! Cash lowers his head, smirking slyly. Dora looks at Carl, horrified. DORACarl, the stillbirth was my own fall;

it had nothing to do with Ava. Ava's our daughter, don’t treat her this way. CARLShe’s a devil! It must be her curse that led to her stillborn brother's death. I was merciful not to send her to an orphanage! Ava, furious and heartbroken, finally explodes. AVADad! How can you say that about me? And why won’t you let Mom get treated? Why do I have to give up my job? Cash’s job is far less sought-after than mine! Tears stream down Ava’s face as she cries uncontrollably. CASHAva, stop shouting! Mom is still sick! You’re a girl—just listen to Dad. He knows what’s best for you! DORANo, Ava needs to work too. I just need some rest, then I’ll be fine... Before Dora can finish, she starts coughing. Mary steps forward, glaring at Dora. MARYOh Dora, shut up! Look at yourself, you're in no shape to cook and clean for us? Cash's career has only just started! Ava will stay put and take care of us, and hopefully land herself a rich husband! Ava, trembling with anger, wipes her tears away. AVAFine! I’ll earn the travel expenses myself! No treatment for Mom? I’ll save up and pay for that myself, too! You and Cash can be the family you want. Even if I have to borrow money, I’ll leave this place! Carl sneers and shoves a stack of cash into Cash’s hands.

CARLCash, here’s your allowance. Don’t skimp on yourself now that you’ve started working. CASH(excited) *Dad, this is a big money! CARLSpend it on networking. You’ll need it. I’ll give you more each month! Mary adds cash from her purse, handing it to Cash. MARYHere, take this too! Cash pockets the money with a wide grin. CASHThanks, Dad. Thanks, Grandma! Ava, watching the trio revel in harmony, tries to speak but is stopped by Dora, who grabs her arm and shakes her head. DORADon’t say anything more. If you anger your father, he’ll lock you up like me, and you’ll never escape. As the three leave, Dora coughs blood. Seeing this, Ava bursts into tears. AVAMom! I promise I’ll find a way to get you treated!
EXT. OUTSIDE OF TOM’S HOUSE - DAY3 3
Ava hesitates at the door, unsure whether to knock. AVA (V.O.)Uncle Tom has always been kind to me, encouraging me to study. He’ll probably lend me the money, right?

Ava gathers her courage and is about to knock when the door suddenly opens. TOM (middle-age, unmarried neighbor) sees Ava standing there and is momentarily surprised. TOMAva? What brings you here? (noticing her hesitation)Come in if you need something!
INT. TOM’S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY4 4

Ava exhales in relief and steps into Tom’s house. Tom locks the door behind them, a sly grin appearing on his face. Ava sits on the sofa while Tom takes a seat next to her. AVAUncle Tom, you know my mom is sick. I’ve also received an job offer from a big company, but my dad won’t let me leave or give me travel expenses. Could you please lend me some money? Ava nervously clasps her hands together, unaware that Tom is eyeing her up and down. TOMDon’t worry. How much do you need? AVACan I borrow $1,000... She turns to face Tom, only to find his face uncomfortably close, startling her. She recoils, putting distance between them. Tom pulls out a check, fills in it and stuffs it into Ava’s pocket, gripping her hand excitedly. TOMHere’s $10,000. Ava. AVAThank you so much, uncle Tom. TOMThis little sum of money is nothing. If you marry me, I’ll give you everything... Tom grows more agitated and reaches out to hug Ava.

AVA(crying)Uncle Tom! What are you doing? Stop! Stop! Unable to break free, Ava grabs a mug from the table and smashes it against Tom’s head. Tom collapses, dazed. Ava pushes him away forcefully. AVA(cont'd)You’re disgusting! If it wasn't for my mother's sickness, I would never borrow money from you. I’ll pay you back double in the future. Tom crawls toward Ava, trying to grab her leg. Ava screams and runs out.

I’ll walk my own path! Ava storms out angrily, but suddenly, Mary appears at the bedroom door, grabbing Ava’s hair. Ava screams in pain. MARYYou little bitch! You’re not going anywhere!

DORAWhat did you say? Say it again. AVAI’ll stay and take care of you— Before Ava can finish, Dora slaps her hard. DORAListen to me carefully! If you give up your job and your future for me, I’ll die right here and now! Do you think I’ve worked so hard for you to stay trapped here, in fear and poverty? I want you to have a better life!
